claim: Zero-ETL integrations with Amazon Redshift became generally available for an Aurora PostgreSQL source DB cluster on October 15, 2024; they make transactional data available in Amazon Redshift within seconds of it being written.
question: When did Aurora PostgreSQL zero-ETL integration with Amazon Redshift become generally available?

values.display: within seconds of it being written to an Aurora PostgreSQL source DB cluster

qualifiers.scope: Aurora PostgreSQL zero-ETL integration with Amazon Redshift

note: Replaces a self-built ETL pipeline for near real-time analytics.
